name: Pure Evil

tenures.note: Formed on camera at Blood Factory's own main event: Matrix turns on Dess after a handshake ("You want Cyberforce!?...TOO BAD!!") and The DT runs in from the crowd to hit Dess with the Destruction Driver, the two of them raising hands together as Matrix declares "a new era... PURE EVIL!!"; ranked #5 on the fed's own 13 June tag rankings.

caption: Matrix and The DT's own stable, formed by a post-match beatdown of Dess at Blood Factory.

name: The Black Riders

tenures.note: Revealed at Blood Factory when Volcano, having rallied ringside for The Court moments earlier, turns on Dess and chokeslams him — he is wearing a Black Riders shirt underneath his Court shirt; ranked, inactive, on the fed's own 13 June tag rankings. No document in the held record names another member.

caption: Volcano's own stable, revealed by a mid-match heel turn on Dess at Blood Factory.

name: The Court

tenures.note: Revealed at Ides of March when three security guards blocking Sub-Beast's own corner tear off their shirts, Katy Hummer named as its own leader; Jordan Hammer and Adam King wrestle under its own banner at High Stakes. By High Stakes the commentary also describes a "strong bond" tying Dess, Archangel and a newly arrived Volcano to the group, none of whom is recorded here as a member on the strength of that alone; Volcano turns on the group at Blood Factory, revealed as a Black Rider underneath his own Court shirt.

caption: The heel stable Katy Hummer revealed running WMW from behind the Commissioner's own desk.

identity.note: Shares its name with the-black-riders-wmw, WMW's own earlier stable revealed at Blood Factory (2003-05), whose only attested member is Volcano. No document connects the two rosters beyond the shared name and promotion; filed distinct under the collision doctrine, since the same recurring WMW stable name across a roster this different (Volcano solo in 2003, Umbrage and Garvin as Tag Champions in 2005) is genuine ambiguity, not a bare coincidence.
